proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphRevertTrigger: target_bonus_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The target can voluntarily end the transformation as a Bonus Action — a distinct revert trigger not covered by spell_ends or zero_hp. Currently only spell_ends, zero_hp, temp_hp_depleted, and dismissed_by_caster exist.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The transformation lasts for the duration or until the target ends it as a Bonus Action.

proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphActionRestriction: no_spells_only
proposed_widenings.justification: The target cannot cast spells but RETAINS its ability to communicate. The only existing variant, no_speech_no_spells, incorrectly suppresses communication. This encoding omits actionRestriction entirely to avoid a dishonest trace.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target retains its... ability to communicate... and it can't cast spells.

proposed_widenings.name: PolymorphFormSource: maxSize field
proposed_widenings.justification: Animal Shapes constrains the beast form to Large or smaller. PolymorphFormSource only supports creatureType and crBound; there is no size ceiling field.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each target shape-shifts into a Large or smaller Beast of your choice that has a Challenge Rating of 4 or lower.

notes: Core mechanics encode cleanly: ongoing_effect with any_number target selection, initialPhase direct-transform (tempHpFromForm=true), and on_caster_spends_action(magic) re-transform operation (no tempHpFromForm). Typecheck passes; tracer emits a valid graph with no throws. Three surface variants are missing: (1) target Bonus Action voluntary revert, (2) no_spells_only action restriction (communication retained), (3) maxSize on PolymorphFormSource. Additionally, 'ability to communicate' is approximated as the 'languages' retained field — the closest available PolymorphRetainedField.
